title: Run hands-on training
summary: People learn product skills by doing them. Keep training short and practical, using real work, and follow it up so it sticks.

beginner: Pick one skill area to train first.
Design a short session built around an exercise.
Use people's real products as the examples.
Set a task to apply the skill within two weeks.
Check how it went in a follow-up session.
intermediate: Build a short learning path for each level.
Mix training with coaching and on-the-job practice.
Ask experienced PMs to run some sessions.
experienced: Design a programme across levels and roles.
Link training to the career framework.
Measure whether behaviour changes, not just attendance.

toolExamples.miro: Run exercises on a shared board.
toolExamples.confluence: Publish session materials and follow-up tasks.
